verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for a cloud application platform, since some PaaS products publish their source, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Render publishing its platform source under an open license. The pack covers only the managed service, CLI, MCP server, SDKs, and API docs, with no mention of source availability or licensing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
